goal: Eliminate POI loss: reconcile unconfirmed and raw coordinate visits against canonical places catalog and reverse geocoding

Run API contract audits, unit tests, and verify fix end-to-end
Implement place_aliases table and alias tracking in place_reconciler.py and importer.py to permanently handle mutated/new Place IDs
